newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer still hopeful on Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Placer still hopeful on Bre-X.

text.p: Canadian miner Placer Dome Inc said Friday it remains hopeful that its bid to merge with Bre-X Minerals Ltd will find favor with the Indonesian government despite a report to the contrary.
A source in the Indonesian mines ministry told Reuters in Jakarta that the government was not likely to accept Placer's involvement in development of Bre-X's rich Busang gold find.

The ministry replied Friday to a joint venture proposal by Bre-X and Barrick Gold Corp. The contents of the reply were unclear but ministry Secretary-General Umar Said said the companies were told to settle with their local partners soon.
"I don't think this has changed anything substantially. We still await an official response," a Placer spokesman said.
He said Placer remains hopeful. "Very much so. We had encouragement...that our proposal has a strong chance of success."

He noted other news reports have said that Placer's deal has greater political appeal in Indonesia. The US$5 billion merger offer would provide a 40 percent stake in the project for Indonesian interests including the government while the Barrick deal entails only a 10 percent slice to the government.

The Placer spokesman said the various reports left the impression that "these are opinions being expressed rather than any decision...There are going to be a number of conflicting opinions along the way."
